cells.gaps: No share of local offices entering on VitalReg is established: 3,372 wards activated (NGA-027, 18 July 2026) has no total of wards, and the 4,011 registration centres (NGA-014, NGA-023, NGA-035) are a count of centres whose facts say they do not state how many enter on the platform; the two counts disagree and are of different units. NGA-027 also says only 15 states have ward registrars while other rows say all 36 states and the FCT, and paper fallback where the network fails is reported (NGA-001, NGA-040, NGA-041). Finance is donor or not stated; no domestic budget line is held.
cells.note: Births and deaths are entered at ward and local government offices on the national platform from 1 July 2026, but the offices figure is a count with no denominator, which is a floor and places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a denominator.
